items.question: Which architectural styles and layout are permitted for the prescribed construction?
premises: The nāgara style is an admissible form.
The drāviḍa style is an admissible form.
The vesara style is an admissible form.
The construction is to be four-sided in layout.
items.inference: The prescribed construction may be executed in nāgara, drāviḍa, or vesara style, provided it is four-sided.
uncertainties: Whether caturāyatam specifies a strictly quadrangular plan or a more general fourfold extension is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: One may make it in the nāgara, drāviḍa, or vesara style, in a four-sided form.
